metadata.title: Dancing with the SARs — static mock grids
metadata.grid_note: Browser grids are 2x downsampled from canonical xarray data.

table_mountain.name: Table Mountain / Cape Peninsula
table_mountain.description: Fire-prone, steep fynbos slopes above the City Bowl.

cape_flats.name: Cape Flats Aquifer
cape_flats.description: Low-gradient sandy aquifer with groundwater abstraction.

silvermine.name: Silvermine Fynbos Catchment
silvermine.description: Steep fynbos headwaters draining toward False Bay.

jonkershoek.name: Jonkershoek, Stellenbosch
jonkershoek.description: Steep sandstone fynbos catchment in the Jonkershoek valley east of Stellenbosch.

theewaterskloof.name: Theewaterskloof Dam
theewaterskloof.description: Open water and the slopes around a large storage reservoir. Terrain: reservoir and foothills.

atlantis.name: Atlantis aquifer
atlantis.description: Sandy coastal plain used for groundwater supply. Terrain: low coastal aquifer.

hottentots_holland.name: Hottentots Holland / Grabouw
hottentots_holland.description: Mountain slopes and farmed foothills between Grabouw and the Hottentots Holland ridge.

cederberg.name: Cederberg
cederberg.description: Rocky sandstone mountains and dry-summer fynbos in the central Cederberg.

palisades.name: Los Angeles / Palisades
palisades.description: Fire and drought hotspot on steep coastal hills. Post-fire rain can move sediment.

attica.name: Attica, Greece
attica.description: Fire and drought hotspot on dry Mediterranean hills. Summer fire is followed by flash runoff.

valparaiso.name: Valparaíso, Chile
valparaiso.description: Fire and drought hotspot on steep coastal hills above a port city.

blue_mountains.name: Blue Mountains, Australia
blue_mountains.description: Fire and drought hotspot on a forested sandstone escarpment.

central_valley.name: Central Valley, California
central_valley.description: Groundwater hotspot on a flat irrigated valley floor. Pumping can lower the land surface.
